title: Fractured Worlds
description: Fractured Worlds is a nine-level mapset featuring environments that range from tech gardens and deep caverns to grand neo-gothic architecture and void spaces. Distinctive for its altered teal palette, the set mixes incidental combat, platforming, and set-piece encounters. Each level includes a secret fight accessed via a hidden purple keycard, along with custom monsters like void cacodemons and teal cyberdemons.
